notes.title: Zombie Monster Update (Build 524)
notes.content:
Today the Zombie gets a Monster Update. He is still your friendly Undead Friend, but with some changes and fixes listed below.

[h1]Changes[/h1]
[list]
[*] Updated Localisation
[*] Updated Steamworks
[*] Updated Updated Sleeping XP
[*] Fixed Spray Sound
[*] Fixed Zombie Reset
[*] Fixed some Icons
[*] Fixed some UI Positions
[*] Balanced Mini Games
[*] Balanced Values
[*] Reorganized Bedroom Furniture
[*] Changes WAZ Happy Face
[*] Lowered Faces difficulty
[*] Balanced Mini-Game rewards
[*] Changed clothes/outfit prices
[*] Changed clothes/outfit sorting
[*] and much more...
[/list]

Please use the Steam Bug Report Discussion to report Bugs and balancing issues.

Thanks for your Support. ːzheartː
Have Fun and Enjoy the Game!

notes.title: Zombie Gotchi Halloween Update (Build 480)
notes.content:
For Halloween we have Updated the Zombie to Build 490, this is a massive jump from Build 375 with tons of changes and additions as also fixes. 

[b]With this update the Zombie Storage changed and your old friend will be converted into the new System. It can be found at the first slot in the Zombie selection.[/b]

[h1]Changes[/h1]
[list]
[*] Added Main Menu
[*] Added Sounds FX
[*] Added Music
[*] Added Ambience Sounds
[*] Added Profiles
[*] Added Zombie Upgrade to new Data Format
[*] Added Jump on Click to Hurdle Game
[*] Added Random Name Generator
[*] Added back to Main Menu
[*] Updated Loading Screen
[*] Updated Automatic Zombie Saving
[*] Updated Options
[*] Updated Greens Screen (Experimental Streaming Mode)
[*] Updated Cursor Logic
[*] Updated Steamworks to Latest
[*] Updated Statistic Storage
[*] Fixed Confetti
[*] Fixed Whac-A-Zombie Mini-Game
[*] Fixed Hurdle Race Mini-Game
[*] Fixed Faces Mini-Game
[*] Fixed Frame Rate Drop
[*] Fixed Experience and Brains Drop
[*] Fixed Moving UI
[*] Fixed Menu Click Interaction
[*] Fixed Zombie Interaction
[*] Fixed Highscore Messages
[*] Fixed different Sprites not Shown
[*] Fixed Hurdle Race Trap Animations
[*] Fixed Language Selection
[*] Fixed Initial Language
[*] Moved Brains from Account to Zombie
[/list]

Please use the Steam Bug Report Discussion to report Bugs and balancing issues.

Thanks for your Support. ːzheartː
Have Fun and Enjoy the Game!
